normalization_plan.reason: Unicorn identifier parameter is only meaningful for the breeding and market core functions that validate and mutate the unicorn state
First parent identifier is consumed exclusively by the hybridization core function when charging, freezing and breeding
Second parent identifier is consumed exclusively by the hybridization core function for ownership and freeze checks
ETH asking price parameter is stored by the listing core function and later read by the offer price getters
Presale count parameter bounds the minting loop inside the presale core function
Candy percent parameter is validated and written into dividend state by the configuration core function
Locally read hybridization price drives the chocolate token charge and the emitted price in the breeding core function
Freshly minted unicorn id flows directly into the blackBox.geneCore unsafe external call and the creation event
Resolved seller address is the recipient of the unsafe external ETH transfer performed by the buy core function
